description: AMD implementation for dust.js, providing module loading, environment detection (browser, Node.js, Java), and text fetching mechanisms.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the module text if available in buildMap, using the write callback.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the dust.js module depending on environment (browser or Node.js).

methods.name: process
methods.description: Fetches HTML content, compiles it with dust, and prepares it for module loading.
